prompt: 这是客户给的 AI 短剧脚本，帮我做脚本审核和脚本与资产确认表，给客户确认用。
expected_behavior: identify the source script and current phase before writing files
create a client-facing workbook with 脚本审核确认表 first and 形象场景描述确认表 second
mark missing product/logo/font/music/materials as 待提供
include client decision columns and block downstream prompt generation until confirmation
must_not: put internal Prompt production language in the client-facing workbook
treat unconfirmed script changes as approved

prompt: 客户要先看人物和场景设定图，帮我出内部设定资产制作表和生成 Prompt。
expected_behavior: place the workbook under 05_内部制作执行
write or revise actual asset prompts after reading script context
separate producer-facing prompt work from client-facing confirmation files
tell the user that generated images must be回填到确认表 before client confirmation
must_not: put 设定资产制作表 into 02_用户确认文件
present internal prompts as final client-approved deliverables

prompt: 客户看完 5 秒样片后要求改角色服装颜色，你帮我记录修改意见并更新后续表。
expected_behavior: record original client wording, sample version, affected shots/assets, and affected duration
use neutral client-facing wording for affected generated duration
update downstream confirmation or prompt workbook only after recording the revision
state which files are affected and what remains blocked
must_not: use accusatory wording in client-facing archive
merge separate feedback rounds into one vague note
